༄༅/ /nam mkha' skor gsum las/nam mkha' rab 'byams bzhugs pa legs/ /rin chen shog skya'i skor rgyab chos kyi rim pa las/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /nam mkha' skor gsum las/ nam mkha' rab 'byams bzhugs pa legs/ /

rin chen shog skya'i skor rgyab chos kyi rim pa las/ nam mkha' rab 'byams zhes bya ba/ /dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye nas ma bcos rang bzhin rdzogs pa che/ /brjod med bsam 'das mnyam nyid ngang nyid las/ /sna tshogs 'char sgo ye shes rigs lnga'i gdangs/ /rang shar rang sar grol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar snang 'gyu ba ye shes rol pa'i dbyings/ /dran 'dzin gnyen po'i blo las 'das pa ni/ /gang dang mi 'gal kun las 'das pa'i don/ /ji ltar bdag gis rtogs bzhin bshad kyis nyon/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i ngang nyid las/ /skye med lhun rdzogs snying po'i gdangs shar ba/ /yon tan rang bzhin can yang 'dzin pa'i blos/ /sna tshogs 'khor ba'i sems zhes btags par snang*/ /rang gi rang bzhin yang nas yang shar ba/ /chu dang rlabs bzhin ye shes rgya mtsho'i ngang*/ /gzhi med rtsa bral rig pa'i rlabs shar ba/ /chos nyid ngang las byung zhing ngang du thim/ /rang shar rang grol chos sku'i rol pa che/ /sna tshogs 'char sgo chos dbyings kun tu bzang*/ /de nyid 'dzin med kun tu bzang mo'i klong*/ /nyon mongs dug lnga ye shes rigs lnga'i gdangs/ /zhi khro'i rang bzhin can de lhun gyis grub/ /rmongs pa rnams kyi kun tu rtog ces btags/ /bde chen gnas de spong ba'i thabs la brtson/ /ye shes rgya mtsho nyid las 'phros pa'i rlabs/ /ngo bo rten bral rang bzhin so sor gsal/ /thugs rjes sems can kun la khyab pa'i tshul/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis mthong nas rab tu grol/ /sna tshogs 'char gzhi ma 'gags rig pa'i rtsal/ /yon tan rang bzhin can yang skyon ltar snang*/ kye ma'o/ /srid pa'i rang bzhin log pa'i blo/ /rang gis nye bar btags pas bslad par zad/ /rang bzhin nyid la rnam par 'phros pa'i sems/ /gang ltar shar yang ji ltar ma grub pa/ /shar tsam nyid nas rang shar rang sar grol/ /gnyen pos ma bslad spang byas bsgyur du med/ /so ma gnyug ma ma bcos rang ka ma/

/rang bzhin lhug pa ye grol chos nyid la/ /bcings dang grol med nam mkha'i mdud pa bzhin/ / spang blang 'khrul pa'i byung khungs zad pa yin/ /ched 'dzin gnyer kha ma byed yan du chug /bzang ngan blang dor thams cad spros pa'i blo/ /de la ched 'dzin zhig na ye shes dngos/ /thad kar bsgom yang ci dgos gang bder thong*/ / gang la 'dzin pa yod na 'ching byed nyid/ /gnyis 'dzin rtog pa'i gzeb yin dgos pa med/ /dgag sgrub spang blang med pa sna tshogs sems/ /gang shar gang yin yin gyis rol du chug /thams cad 'di yin med kyis gnyug ma'i sems/ /sna tshogs 'char sgo ma 'gag gzhi bral dang*/ /yul dang dus med snang la ngos gzung bral/ /stong la kun khyab 'char nub rnyog bral ba/ /dag pa'i sems la 'dzin pas ma bslad cig /rang 'gros sems de ye shes khyab gdal lo/ /mi mkhas mi dag mtshan mo'i mun rum na/ /cang shes rta dag rang 'gros mi btang bar/ /rang gis bsgyur bas lam nor sdug bsngal zhing*/ / mkhas pa dag gis de las bzlog pa yis/ /'dod pa'i gnas su rang gar phyin pa bzhin/ /mi mkhas byis pa dag gis sems bzung ste/ /bde gnas mi rtog stong nyid snying po'i blos/ /lus bcings ngag bsdams sems sgrims mnyam par 'jog /sngags zlos lha bskyed kha lo bsgyur ba yis/ /rtsol zhing 'bad pa de srid lam 'khyams te/ /'khor ba'i gnas las grol ba'i skabs med do/ /mkhas pa dag gis gang shar rig pa'i sems/ /ma gzung ma bslad ma bsgyur rang babs dang*/ /tha mal shes pa rang grol nyid btang bas/ /rang ka'i sems te cang shes ye shes rta/ /bde chen gnas su 'bad med phyin par byed/ /kye ma rmongs pa dag ni sems zhum ste/ /tha mal shes pa gnyen pos bzhu btul byed/ /kyi hud de ltar 'bad pas 'khor bar 'ching*/ /sdug bsngal nyid las grol ba'i skabs med do/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i mtsho las shar ba'i rlabs/ /dgag cing sgrub med rang bzhin shes pas grol/

/grogs dag tshur nyon shes rab rig pa'i mtshon/ /rang gi sems la 'di ltar brtag 'tshal lo/ /sna tshogs 'gyu ba rlung 'dra brtags na med/ /ma brtag ltar snang 'di la soms dang kye/ /da ltar gar gnas dang po gang nas byung*/ /tha ma gar 'gro kha dog dbyibs 'dug gam/ bltas pas mthong ngam 'di zhes ngos gzung 'dug /legs par rtogs dang dran bsam kun las 'das/ /gang las ma byung gang du ma song zhing*/ /gang na'ang mi gnas sna tshogs rig pa'i sems/ /ma brtag snang yang snang ba'i sems 'dug gam/ /rang bzhin 'di zhes ri mor byas pa'i gzugs/ /dgag sgrub yin zhes so sor bris 'dug gam/ /dgag sgrub sems de nga yin 'dir yod ces/ /brjod mkhan 'dug gam rang gis brtags la soms/ /rang gi btags pa nyid las gzhan med do/ /de ltar btags kyang brtags pa'i don du med/ /tsha ba'i me la bsil ba'i chur btags kyang*/ /me nyid chur 'gyur mngon sum srid dam ci/ / brtags pas don der 'gyur ba ga la yin/ /ma btags don zhes de las logs na med/ /btags dang ma btags tha snyad rmi lam 'dra/ /des na dgag sgrub dgra gnyen 'khor 'das chos/ /btags pa tsam ste don la grub pa med/ /med ces brjod pa'ang rang gis btags pa tsam/ /brtags pa'i don la 'di zhes ngos gzung med/ /des na sna tshogs dgag sgrub ca ིra shar yang*/ /de ltar soms dang don la grub 'dug gam/ /btags pa'i chos la don du bzung bas 'khrul/ /'khrul pa'i sems de rang 'gros btang bas grol/ /grol ba'i sems gang sngon nas bcings pa med/ /med pa'i chos la spu ris so sor 'byed/ /'byed mkhan 'dug gam rig pa'i mtshon gyis gzhig /kye ho 'gro kun bcings dang grol ba med/ /gang gis gang bcings 'ching rgyu 'dug gam ci/ /ma bcings sems de grol ba rdul tsam med/ /'gro ba drug ces brda tsam btags pa tsam/ /gang du gang 'khor 'khor mkhan soms dang kye/ /'khor ba po med ngos gzung dmigs su med/

kha dog dbyibs bral skyon yon gzung 'dzin 'das/ /de 'dra'i sems la skye shi 'dug gam ci/ /'chi med skye shi kun las 'das pa'i sems/ /bar do'i yul la 'jug pa ga la 'gyur/ /mo gsham bu de skye shi bar dor 'jug /sna tshogs sdug bsngal myong zhes ltar 'dug gam/ /'on kyang mo gsham bu zhes ming tsam btags/ /de bzhin bsal bzhag 'gro 'ong med pa'i sems/ /mi tsam nyid las ngos gzung rdul tsam med/ /skye shi snang ba tha snyad rmi lam 'dra/ /ji ltar rmi lam nang na bdag nyid shi/ /de nas bar dor 'jug dang skyer snang yang*/ /rang gi mal la cung zad g.yos pa med/ /skye med shi med bar dor phyin pa med/ /ye grol chos nyid ngang las g.yos pa med/ /thams cad nam mkha' 'dra bar rtogs par bya/ /kye ho grogs dag rang gi sems la ltos/ /gang gis gang bsgom sgom rgyu 'dug gam ci/ /bsgoms pas sems de gangs ri ltar dkar zhing*/ /ma bsgoms sol ba'i mdog bzhin 'gro 'dug gam/ /rtogs dang rtog med bde gsal bskyed dang rdzogs/ /gang zhig bsgoms pas sems de der gyur na/ /phyin chad gzhan 'byung rtog tshogs khegs sam ci/ /cung zad bsgoms pas khegs pa ltar snang yang*/ / 'bad pa rdzing bur bskyil ba'i chu bzhin du/ /kun rtog spros pa'i chu klung yul la 'babs/ /sna tshogs rtog pa sngon bas rags par snang*/ /de bzhin 'khrul pa'i rtog pa gang shar bas/ /sems ni bsgyur zhing nag por 'gror 'dug gam/ /de ltar gyur na mi rtog dge ba'i sems/ /'gro ba rnams la skabs 'gar 'byung mi srid/ /des na gang shar rtsis gdab ma byed cig / 'phros sam 'gyus kyang mi dgar don la med/ /gnas sam zin yang de la dgar ci yod/ /rang bzhin babs yin bcos bslad ma byed cig /bde ba'i sems la stong pa'i rgyas gdab kyang*/ /'dod pa'i khams las cung zad mi 'da' zhing*/ /gsal dang mi rtog gzugs dang gzugs med de/

/chags pa bkag nas stong par bsgom kyang sla'i/ /bder 'gro'i gnas gsum dag las 'da' mi nus/ /chags na ngan song gnas gsum so sor 'ching*/ /gang ltar byas kyang srid las grol mi nus/ /gang ltar shar yang de ltar mi 'dzin na/ /srid par mi gnas mya ngan 'da' mi gnas/ /rang grol mnyam pa'i ngang du mya ngan 'da'/ /grogs dag soms dang ji ltar bsgoms kyang sla'i/ / bsgoms pa'i don der sems de yod dam med/ /yod na grub zin sgom yang ci zhig dgos/ /med na bsgoms kyang don med ngal ba'i rgyu/ /bden te don der gsal 'debs yin zhe na/ /med na mi gsal yod na dgos pa med/ / gang ltar byas kyang blo ni gnyen po'i chos/ /de la 'khrul pa'i gzeb yod 'ching byed yod/ /gang du'ang mi gzo rang dgar gtam shes na/ sus kyang mi 'ching srid zhi'i mtha' las 'das/ /ji srid sgom yod lta dang spyod pa yod/ / de srid chos yod theg pa'i zhe 'dod yod/ /de la srid yod 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal yod/ /gang la chos med theg pa'i zhe 'dod med/ /de la srid med srid pa'i sdug bsgal med/ /nam mkha' 'dra ste gang gis gos par 'gyur/ / de ltar gzhi dang rtsa ba legs chod nas/ /nyin dang mtshan mo cir snang khyad par med/ /dran pa'i rtsis med rmi lam bzung ci dgos/ /spel dang bsgyur med sbyang rgyu ci zhig yod/ /ji ltar rmi lam skye bo 'gro dang 'dug /'chag dang nyal dang za dang 'thung ba dang*/ dga' dang mi dga' sna tshogs cir snang yang*/ /rang 'gros nyid las dran 'dzin gnyen po med/ /rmi lam 'di yin rmis pa po 'di zhes/ /gnyis su mi rtog gnyis med rtog pa med/ /gang shar don las logs pa'i rtsis gdab med/ /de tshe rmi lam dge sdig ci snang yang*/ /der 'dzin med pas las med rnam smin med/ /de bzhin gnyid sad nyin dus snang ba yang*/ /'di bzhin mi 'dzin rmi lam skyes bu bzhin/ /rang babs nyid las gnyen pos mi gzo na/

/'ching ba'i gzeb med las 'bras rnam smin med/ /kye ho grogs dag dran rig 'gyur ba'i sems/ /bu chung bzhin te rang babs gang dgar thong*/ /dran bsam 'dzin bral smyon pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /gang babs gang byung thog babs chen por thongs/ /rang babs lhod chags rgan po'i ngang tshul can/ /gzeb bral khong yangs gang shar rag babs thong*/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i dgongs klong yangs pa yin/ / sna tshogs dran rig thams cad ye shes dngos (< a > ye shes ngang ) / /rang shar rang grol kun bzang chos kyi sku/ /lhun grub ngang yin ye nas gnas pa yin/ /de ltar kun bzang nyid las gzhan pa'i chos/ /rdul tsam mi rnyed ye nas sangs rgyas yin/ /de ltar shes te 'ching grol kun las 'das/ /rang bzhin gzhi yi dgongs klong yangs pa yin/ /kye ho grogs dag sna tshogs rig pa'i sems/ /gang du shar yang der 'dzin med pa'i tshe/ /ji ltar snang yang gang gis mi gos pa/ /me long dngos la shar ba'i gzugs brnyan 'dra/ / sems nyid ye nas dag pa'i me long la*/ /sna tshogs dgag sgrub gzugs brnyan ci shar yang*/ /de yis mi gos 'char gzhi dgag tu med/ /rang bzhin sgrub med rang snang bden pas stong*/ /ji ltar me long mdun gyi gzugs de yang*/ /'char gzhi'i rgyu byed me long nang shar yang*/ /gzugs de me long ngos la 'phos pa med/ /de bzhin snang la snang yang ngos gzung med/ /me long gzugs der ye nas grub pa med/ /de bzhin ye nas dag pa'i me long 'di/ /gang du ma grub gang gi'ang 'char gzhi byed/ /dge sdig dgag sgrub phyi rol rkyen gyi gzugs/ /sna tshogs snang tshe de yi gzugs brnyan sems/ / dge sdig dgag sgrub ltar snang yod mod kyang*/ /sems la de med dngos bzung kun las 'das/ /'dzin med dge sdig dgag sgrub ci shar yang*/ / rang bzhin dag pa'i sems la gos pa med/ /sna tshogs sems 'di gang du'ang ma grub pas/ /gang du'ang snang ba'i 'char gzhi me long 'dra/

/gcig nyid yin na du ma'i 'char gzhir 'gal/ /du mar ma nges ngos gzung cung zad med/ /de phyir sems la dge sdig dgag sgrub med/ /phyi rol rkyen gyis sna tshogs so sor snang*/ /rkyen la ma gzung de yis gos pa med/ /bzung na 'ching la ma bzung rang sar grol/ /sna tshogs shar yang gang gis ma gos pa/ /dri med sems nyid dag pa'i me long 'dra/ /de bzhin sgyu ma smig rgyu chu zla dang*/ /rang bzhin sprul pa lta bur snang ba'i sems/ /gzhi med rten bral snang la ngos gzung med/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag par shes par gyis/ /gang gis ma bzung bcos bslad med pa'i sems/ /rang bzhin nyid de gang babs rang dga'i ngang*/ /srid 'byung sgyu mar rnam spyod ye shes dngos/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin yang nas yang shar ba/ /bde gshegs snying pos 'gro kun yongs khyab pa'o/ /mi shes byis pa dag gis de bslad de/ /srid pa'i nags khrod 'thug por rang nyid 'ching*/ /las dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal dgras gtses shing*/ /yan lag bcu gnyis rnam 'gros lugs su 'jug /rang bzhin shes pa dag gis 'di rig na/ /'khor ba'i 'brog dgon dag ni rab brgal zhing*/ /ma rig la sogs lugs las ldog pa'i chos/ /rang bzhin de rig shes rab pha rol phyin/ /byang chub snying po'i sems de khyab gdal ba/ /gzhi med rten bral rang grol chos kyi sku/ /gang ltar shar yang sna tshogs rig pa'i sems/ /shes rab rtogs pa'i me long ngos shar ba'i/ /gzugs brnyan gsal ba 'gro kun snying la gnas/ /gang shar blo rnams rang grol skad cig ma/ /zhen 'dzin 'khrul par snang yang dgag ci dgos/ /ston ka'i mkha' la dri med 'od stong ldan/ /chu skyes pad+mo'i sbubs su 'ongs pa bzhin/ /rtogs pa'i nyi ma nang nas shar ba'i gzugs/ /the tshom mun pa ma lus kun bcom zhing*/ /mtha' bral blo yi pad kha rab rgyas te/ /bde chen 'od kyi snang bas 'jig rten khyab/ /da ni srid pa'i grong las 'das pa snyam/

/'di ltar rtogs nas su la'ang dri rgyu med/ /skyid pa'i nyi ma nang nas shar ba'i mthus/ /de ring bdag blo dga' ba'i dpal 'di rgyas/ /kye ho grogs dag rang bzhin snying po'i sems/ /sna tshogs shar yang de yin dgag sgrub med/ /ched du ma 'dzin ye nas rang bzhin grol/ /'bad pas ma yin rtsol med blo bde ba'o/ /gang dgar 'khrol bas rang bzhin rigs lnga'i gdangs/ /ye shes chen po ye nas rang shar ba/ /mi rtog dran bsam bral ba'i sems nyid ni/ /rnam snang chos dbyings ye shes bde gshegs rigs/ /sna tshogs 'char gzhi ma 'gags rang shar ba/ /mi bskyod me long ye shes rdo rje'i rigs/ /gang la gnyis med mnyam pa'i rang bzhin sems/ /rin 'byung mnyam nyid ye shes rin chen rigs/ /sna tshogs gang shar ma 'dres so sor 'byed/ /'od dpag sor rtogs ye shes pad+ma'i rigs/ /sna tshogs gang bsam don grub rig pa'i sems/ /don yod bya grub ye shes las kyi rigs/ /'phros sam 'gyur sam gnas pa'i dran rig sems/ /gang ltar shar yang ye shes rigs lnga'i gdangs/ /ji ltar snang yang dgag sgrub bya ci dgos/ /skye med lhun rdzogs ye grol chos nyid la/ /ma bcos rgyal po rang babs lhun 'byams shing*/ /thog babs rang shar lhun grub chen po'i gdangs/ /rang bzhin rdzogs chen nam zhig sus mthong ba/ /skye med lhun rdzogs nam mkha'i ngang du grol/ /gzhi dang snying po kun gyi bcud phyung ba/ /dag pa'i nam mkhar shar ba'i nyi ma'i gzugs/ /sna tshogs dran rig kun bzang klong du shar/ /mi nub 'od kyi snang bas 'jig rten khyab/ /'di ltar rtogs na gang snang 'og min gnas/ /su dang 'grogs kyang rang bzhin rdo rje spun/ /ji ltar 'gyus kyang ting 'dzin yangs pa'i klong*/ /gdod ma'i gnas su mngon par byang chub yin/ /skal bzang skye bo mchog ste rig 'dzin che/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa yis/ /'og min gnas su mngon par byang chub ste/

/thugs rje'i mdzad pas srid pa'i sems can la/ /bla med chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed pa yin/ /de ltar sgom med ye shes rdo rje'i glu/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams ngang du blangs pa 'dis/ /'gro kun rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas/ /gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang du grol bar shog /bdag blo'i yid kyi nam mkha' yangs pa la/ /rtogs pa'i 'od stong dra ba 'byed pa yis/ /phyi nang yid mkha'i mun pa kun gsal te/ /skal ldan blo yi pad+mo rgyas par shog

/tshig tsam ma yin rang bzhin rtogs pa'i don/ phyi rabs rnal 'byor rnams kyi don du bkod/ / 'bad med rang sar grol ba'i yi ge 'dis/ /'gro ba'i don kun lhun gyis grub par shog khregs chod kyi yi ge chen po nam mkha' rab 'byams zhes bya ba/ rig 'dzin gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi thugs kyi 'od zer kun nas phog pa'i phrin las kyis rang bzhin gzhir rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ rang gis rtogs pa'i don ji lta bar skal bzang gi slob ma de kho na nyid kyi don mthong ba 'ga'i rtogs pa thag gcad pa'i phyir/ lhun grub pad+ma dkar po'i gnas su bkod pa rdzogs so// //dge'o// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (7)nam mkha' rab 'byams/ -PAGE 120--PAGE 119--PAGE 110-
